srs: The farm irrigation system records Farmer, WateringPlan, IrrigationService, and Field; each has an id attribute. Each Farmer can have zero or more WateringPlan records, and each WateringPlan belongs to exactly one Farmer. Each WateringPlan uses exactly one IrrigationService, and each IrrigationService serves zero or more WateringPlan records. Each IrrigationService manages one or more Field records by composition, and each Field belongs to exactly one IrrigationService. Each Farmer can reference zero or more Field records, and each Field can be referenced by zero or more Farmer records.
